exposure: maternal occupational exposures during the first trimester of pregnancy
cohort: The study included 3938 nulliparous women from the Italian NINFEA mother-child cohort.
finding: Maternal occupational exposures during early pregnancy, including passive smoking, reduced working hours, demanding work, heat, and dust, were associated with various adverse birth outcomes.
mod_finding: Maternal exposure to dust was associated with increased odds of caesarean section.
